trades.reasoning: NTSK is the only candidate with all four confirmation signals: RSI 63.9 in the bullish range, a bullish MACD crossover, price above SMA-20, and a volume surge above 1.5x average. Conviction is medium because the overall market is neutral.

decisions.briefing: The market was mixed and quiet today: NASDAQ rose 0.3% and the S&P 500 slipped 0.2%. The portfolio is still up about 48.9% overall. Cash is just above the $500 threshold with 3 open slots, so I'm putting it into one small medium-conviction position in NTSK, the only candidate with every confirmation signal, volume surge included. The other seven positions stay as they are, and their stop-losses and profit targets keep working automatically.

market_education.summary_en: Today the indexes split: the tech-heavy NASDAQ edged up 0.3% while the broader S&P 500 dipped 0.2%. Moves this small usually mean no single big catalyst; money shifted between sectors instead of entering or leaving the market as a whole. There was no news feed in today's data, so I can't point to a specific headline. The candidate list does show steady strength in software and cybersecurity names such as CRWD, OKTA, QLYS and TENB, while some large chipmakers like NVDA and INTC traded below their 20-day averages.
market_education.summary_zh: 今日美股表現分歧，以科技股為主的納斯達克指數微升0.3%，標普500指數則輕微回落0.2%。指數升跌幅度如此輕微，通常代表市場缺乏單一重大催化因素，資金主要在不同板塊之間輪動，而非整體流入或撤離。由於今日數據未附新聞資料，無法引用具體頭條；但從候選名單可見，CRWD、OKTA、QLYS、TENB等軟件及網絡安全股走勢持續穩健，而NVDA、INTC等大型晶片股則跌穿20日均線。

daily_lesson.explanation_en: Volume confirmation means checking whether a price move comes with much more trading than usual. A rise on heavy volume suggests that many buyers, often large institutions, are behind it, so the move is more likely to last than one on light trading. Today NTSK was the only candidate that combined strong technical signals with a volume surge, which is why I picked it over other high-scoring stocks.
daily_lesson.explanation_zh: 「成交量確認」是指觀察股價變動時，成交量是否明顯高於平日水平。若股價在大成交量下上升，代表背後有大量買盤（往往來自機構投資者）支持，升勢較在淡靜成交下的升幅更具持續性。今日NTSK是唯一同時具備強勁技術訊號及成交量急增的候選股，因此獲優先選入投資組合。
